expectations.text: The actual recipe and generated APIs determine all imports and properties, with no invented table engine inside the design-system component.
expectations.evidence: main.ts/data.ts instantiate application-owned TableController and VirtualizerController over 10,000 records; Table receives author native table children and presentation attributes only. recipe-lit.txt and setup.ts preserve the matching recipe; generated Table/Pagination API records are archived. Grader strict tsc rerun exits 0.

expectations.text: Sorting and page-size changes update displayed records while selection remains owned by the application table model.
expectations.evidence: result.json records descending first amount 9999 then ascending 0, pageSize=100/pageIndex=1 with first amount 100, and stable independent delivery-1 selection. main.ts sends exact page/page-size requests to the application table model.

expectations.text: Virtual scrolling uses TanStack Virtual and renders a bounded number of native rows while reaching records beyond the first viewport.
expectations.evidence: main.ts uses @tanstack/lit-virtual VirtualizerController, keyed native tr rows and spacers. result.json records 10 initial rows and 15 far rows delivery-9497 through delivery-9511 for virtualCount=10000; keyboard then reaches delivery-9512.

expectations.text: Removing the consumer releases listeners and observers, and remount succeeds without duplicate event processing.
expectations.evidence: result.json shows all 18 observed ResizeObserver targets released, scrollElement=null and same-instance reconnect rendering delivery-100 with retained selection. But the harness never counts handler/model invocations after remount, so duplicate event processing is unproven. Observer cleanup is supported; this is not evidence of a leak.

metrics_availability: Host did not supply token counts, duration or full executor tool metrics. Unavailable, not zero.

claims.claim: All 18 observed ResizeObserver targets release on disconnect.
claims.evidence: result.json lifecycle details: before=18, removed.observed=0, removed.scroll=null.

claims.claim: Remount is proved free of duplicate event processing.
claims.evidence: The lifecycle check asserts recovered scrolling/selection but does not instrument callback or update counts.

uncertainties: Both Table configurations originally interpret descendant Select close requests as page-size; explicit action dispatch repairs the consumer bug. main-attempt-1.ts and probe.log retain the failure.
Nine final browser checks pass. Development/update warnings and a favicon 500 remain in the minimal server. Recipe React-source noise is a documentation finding, not a Table runtime defect.

suggestions.assertion: Removing the consumer releases listeners and observers, and remount succeeds without duplicate event processing.
suggestions.reason: Count request/model invocations before and after repeated same-instance reconnects. Recovered scrolling alone cannot rule out duplicate processing; track observer targets and inactive subscriptions too.
Both artifacts initially mishandle bubbled nested close requests. Add an explicit unknown-action invariant: page and page size stay finite and unchanged after unrelated requests.
Filtering is requested by the prompt but is not one of the four assertions. Both saved harnesses exercise it; include stable selection and empty results in common acceptance coverage.

eval_feedback.overall: Same four original assertions applied to both configurations. Final functional harness passes and proof of the compound assertions are recorded separately.

evidence_scope: Original final source, saved results/attempts, verification source, screenshots, current installed version manifests and independent typechecks. Full agent transcripts were not supplied; process claims based only on self-reports are not independently established.
